checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-NETWORK-CONNECT: chainId validation on network connectivity events
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Inject a network connect event via the provider with a chainId that differs from eth_chainId return value. 2. Verify the DApp detects the mismatch and does not proceed with RPC calls using the mismatched chain. 3. Test with chainId=0, chainId=MAX_UINT, and valid-but-wrong chainId values. 4. Confirm that rapid connect/disconnect cycling does not bypass chainId validation.
executable_checks: Send connect event with chainId != eth_chainId response and assert DApp rejects or warns
Send connect event with chainId=0 and verify rejection
Cycle 100 rapid connect/disconnect events and verify no state inconsistency
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-NETWORK-CONNECT crosses from EXT-BLOCKCHAIN-NETWORK into Execution Layer. Trust model: connect/disconnect events derived from manipulable network state. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP2786-03.

checklist.title: Verify connection establishment validates chainId before becoming operational
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Trigger ACTION-ESTABLISH-CONNECTION and verify that chainId from the connect event is stored and compared against eth_chainId. 2. Attempt to issue RPC requests before chainId validation completes. 3. Verify the provider blocks RPC until chainId is confirmed valid.
executable_checks: Assert RPC calls fail or queue while chainId validation is pending
Verify chainId is persisted after successful validation
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-PRECOND-001. Node ACTION-ESTABLISH-CONNECTION supports boundary EDGE-NETWORK-CONNECT.

checklist.title: Falsify: Listener exception isolation during callback invocation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Register 3 listeners: listener A (normal), listener B (throws exception), listener C (normal). 2. Emit a connect event. 3. Verify listener A and C both receive the event despite listener B throwing. 4. Verify the provider itself does not crash or enter an error state. 5. Test with listener B throwing synchronous error, async rejection, and stack overflow.
executable_checks: Register throwing listener between two normal listeners, emit event, assert all non-throwing listeners called
Verify provider remains in CONNECTED state after listener exception
Test async rejection in listener does not crash provider
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2786-PRECOND-005. Pre-condition falsification: attempting to break listener isolation. Primary element: ACTION-INVOKE-LISTENERS. Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP2786-02.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK: parent block ancestry verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a beacon block via P2P where the parent_root references a block NOT in the fork choice store. 2. Verify the block is rejected before state transition processing. 3. Submit a block with parent_root = 0x00...00 (genesis edge case). 4. Submit a block whose parent exists but is from a pruned branch. 5. Verify rejection happens at the ancestry check step, not later in the pipeline.
executable_checks: Send block with unknown parent_root and assert rejection with appropriate error
Send block with zeroed parent_root and verify rejection
Verify fork choice store is not modified by rejected block
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CAPELLA-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK from EXT-NETWORK-PEER-P2P. Trust model requires independent validation of all P2P blocks. Eclipse attack mitigations required.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for precompile address resolution: EIP vs RIP range distinction
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call address 0x01 (EIP range) and verify it routes to the correct EIP precompile. 2. Call address 0x100 (RIP range start) and verify it routes to RIP precompile (or empty account on L1). 3. Call address 0xff (EIP range end) and 0x1ff (RIP range end) to test boundary values. 4. Call address 0x200 (beyond RIP range) and verify normal account behavior. 5. Test with CALL, STATICCALL, DELEGATECALL to ensure consistent resolution across call types.
executable_checks: CALL to 0x01 returns expected EIP precompile result
CALL to 0x100 on L1 behaves as empty account
CALL to 0xff and 0x1ff return correct precompile/empty behavior at range boundaries
CALL to 0x200 behaves as normal account
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7587-PRECOND-001. Boundary: EXT-SMART-CONTRACT-CALLER -> EL. Trust model: address range resolution must correctly distinguish EIP vs RIP spaces.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK: standard validation before IL check
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a block that fails ancestry validation but satisfies inclusion list constraints. 2. Verify rejection occurs at standard validation, not at IL check. 3. Submit a block that fails timing validation (future slot). 4. Verify the IL satisfaction check is never reached for invalid blocks. 5. Monitor validation order via logging/instrumentation.
executable_checks: Send block with bad ancestry + valid IL and assert rejection at ancestry step
Send future-slot block and verify IL check not invoked
Verify validation pipeline order: ancestry -> timing -> data availability -> IL
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7805-PRECOND-001. Boundary edge EDGE-PEER-SENDS-BLOCK. Standard P2P validation must precede inclusion list satisfaction checks.

checklist.title: Falsify: IL-unsatisfied block incorrectly receives proposer boost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Create a block that does NOT satisfy inclusion list constraints. 2. Verify it is added to unsatisfied_inclusion_list_blocks set. 3. Check that proposer boost is NOT applied to this block during fork choice weight calculation. 4. Create a competing block that DOES satisfy IL and verify it receives proposer boost. 5. Verify fork choice head selection prefers the IL-satisfied block.
executable_checks: Assert IL-unsatisfied block exists in unsatisfied_inclusion_list_blocks
Assert proposer boost weight for IL-unsatisfied block is 0
Compare fork choice scores between IL-satisfied and IL-unsatisfied blocks
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7805-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification: attempting to show proposer boost applied to IL-unsatisfied block. Primary element: STATE-BLOCK-IL-UNSATISFIED.

checklist.title: Falsify: Subscription established with invalid transaction parameter
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a subscription request with a transaction parameter containing an invalid RLP-encoded transaction. 2. Verify the subscription is NOT established and a JSON-RPC error is returned. 3. Test with: malformed RLP, invalid signature, zero nonce with existing account, gas price below minimum. 4. Verify that the same validation rules as eth_sendRawTransaction apply.
executable_checks: Send subscription with malformed RLP tx and assert JSON-RPC error
Send subscription with invalid tx signature and assert rejection
Send subscription with valid tx and verify subscription establishes
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP8072-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition falsification on internal node ACTION-VALIDATE-TRANSACTION.

checklist.title: Falsify: Reorg notification not sent when monitored tx block is orphaned
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Establish a transaction monitoring subscription with includeReorgs=true. 2. Wait for the tx to be included in a block and receive 'included' notification. 3. Trigger a chain reorganization that orphans the block containing the monitored tx. 4. Verify a 'reorged' notification is sent with correct details. 5. Verify monitoring resumes for re-inclusion after the reorg notification.
executable_checks: Trigger reorg after tx inclusion and assert 'reorged' notification received
Verify notification contains orphaned block details
Verify subscription remains active and monitors for re-inclusion
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP8072-POSTCOND-003. Post-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-SEND-REORG-NOTIFICATION. Related assumption: ASSUM-EIP8072-03.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for RANDAO value validation from consensus layer
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Inject a block header where mixHash contains a value <= 2^64 in a post-merge context. 2. Verify the system flags this as potentially a PoW difficulty value (pre-merge semantics). 3. Inject a block header with mixHash > 2^64 and verify it is accepted as valid RANDAO. 4. Test boundary value 2^64 exactly. 5. Verify that pre-merge blocks correctly return the difficulty value via opcode 0x44.
executable_checks: Submit post-merge block with mixHash <= 2^64 and check handling
Submit post-merge block with mixHash > 2^64 and verify RANDAO acceptance
Execute PREVRANDAO (0x44) in post-merge block and verify stack contains mixHash value
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4399-PRECOND-001. Boundary property: RANDAO via Engine API (CL->EL boundary). Related ambiguity: AMB-EIP4399-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: RANDAO value unpredictable beyond 4-epoch lookahead
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Given current epoch E, compute the proposer schedule for epochs E through E+4. 2. For each proposer in the schedule, simulate the RANDAO reveal and XOR accumulation. 3. Verify that a proposer at epoch E+4 can predict the RANDAO outcome at that point by knowing all prior reveals. 4. Verify that prediction beyond E+4 requires knowledge of proposers not yet known. 5. Check that applications using RANDAO with < 4-epoch delay are vulnerable to manipulation.
executable_checks: Compute RANDAO for epoch E+4 using known proposer schedule and verify predictability
Verify commit-reveal scheme with 4-epoch delay defeats proposer manipulation
Assert RANDAO at epoch E+5 cannot be predicted without future proposer knowledge
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP4399-INV-002. Invariant falsification: testing predictability window. Primary element: STATE-PROPOSER-KNOWS-OUTCOME. Related: AMB-EIP4399-02, ASSUM-EIP4399-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Merkle Patricia Trie root non-determinism with identical inputs
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a set of key-value pairs with known collisions in trie path prefixes. 2. Compute trie root on two independent trie instances with the same data inserted in different orders. 3. Verify both roots are identical. 4. Test with: empty trie, single entry, entries with shared prefixes, entries that cause branch node splits, maximum depth paths. 5. Test with unicode keys, zero-length values, and maximum-length values.
executable_checks: Compute trie root with data inserted in forward order vs reverse order, assert identical
Compute trie root with random insertion order across 1000 trials, assert all identical
Verify empty trie root matches expected constant
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-CANCUN-INV-002. Invariant falsification: attempting to produce different roots from same input. Primary element: ACTION-COMPUTE-TRIE-ROOT. Related: ASSUM-CANCUN-INDEX-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Gloas fork activation at non-epoch boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Set GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH and attempt fork upgrade at a slot where state.slot % SLOTS_PER_EPOCH != 0. 2. Verify the fork upgrade does NOT activate. 3. Advance to the correct epoch boundary slot and verify activation occurs. 4. Test with slot = GLOAS_FORK_EPOCH * SLOTS_PER_EPOCH - 1 (one slot early). 5. Test with correct epoch but slot offset within the epoch.
executable_checks: Attempt upgrade at mid-epoch slot and assert no fork transition
Attempt upgrade at epoch boundary with wrong epoch and assert no transition
Verify upgrade succeeds at correct epoch boundary slot
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-GLOAS-PRECOND-001. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-CHECK-FORK-CONDITION. Related: AMB-GLOAS-FORK-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Unauthorized builder registration via deposit classification exploit
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Craft a deposit with withdrawal credentials that match the builder prefix but use a pubkey associated with an existing validator. 2. Verify the builder onboarding rejects this deposit (prior validator signature check). 3. Craft a deposit that mimics builder credentials but has a subtle encoding variation. 4. Test with edge cases: empty withdrawal credentials, maximum-length credentials, credentials with valid prefix but invalid body. 5. Verify the builder registry does not contain unauthorized entries after all attacks.
executable_checks: Submit builder deposit with existing validator pubkey and assert rejection
Submit deposit with manipulated withdrawal credentials prefix and assert rejection
Verify builder registry integrity after all attack attempts
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-GLOAS-INV-001. Invariant falsification: attempting unauthorized builder registration. Primary element: STATE-BUILDER-ONBOARDED. Related: ASSUM-GLOAS-FORK-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Cross-client metric interpretation inconsistency for standard ethereum_ metrics
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Query ethereum_blockchain_height from two different client implementations at the same chain state. 2. Verify both return identical values. 3. Query ethereum_best_known_block_number during sync and verify both clients report the same definition (highest known vs highest validated). 4. Query ethereum_peer_count and verify counting methodology is consistent (inbound+outbound vs outbound only). 5. Compare Prometheus exposition format output for structural consistency.
executable_checks: Compare ethereum_blockchain_height across 2+ client implementations at same state
Compare ethereum_peer_count semantics across implementations
Verify Prometheus exposition format compliance for all standard metrics
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP2159-INV-001. Invariant falsification: testing cross-client consistency. Primary element: STATE-METRICS-UPDATED. Related: AMB-EIP2159-02, ASSUM-EIP2159-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: Voluntary exit processed for non-existent or already-exiting validator
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Submit a voluntary exit referencing a validator_index beyond the validator set length. 2. Verify rejection with appropriate error. 3. Submit a voluntary exit for a validator whose exit_epoch != FAR_FUTURE_EPOCH (already exiting). 4. Verify rejection. 5. Submit a voluntary exit for a valid, active validator and verify it succeeds. 6. Immediately resubmit the same exit and verify rejection (now exit_epoch is set).
executable_checks: Submit exit for out-of-range validator index and assert rejection
Submit exit for already-exiting validator and assert rejection
Submit valid exit, then resubmit same exit and assert second rejection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7044-PRECOND-002. Pre-condition falsification. Primary element: ACTION-PROCESS-VOLUNTARY-EXIT.

checklist.title: Falsify: Signed voluntary exit invalid on forked chain with same Capella domain
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Process a voluntary exit on chain A (canonical). 2. Take the same signed exit message and submit it on chain B (fork) that shares the same Capella domain. 3. Verify the exit is accepted on chain B (this is by-design behavior). 4. Verify the validator exits on both chains. 5. Document that this is intentional and not a vulnerability per EIP-7044 design.
executable_checks: Process exit on chain A, replay on chain B with same Capella domain, assert accepted
Verify validator status is 'exiting' on both chains after replay
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7044-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition verification (design-intentional replay). Primary element: ACTION-REPLAY-EXIT-ON-FORK. Related: ASSUM-EIP7044-03.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for Merkle branch verification of execution root
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a light client header with a valid execution root but tampered Merkle branch. 2. Verify the header is rejected at Merkle verification step. 3. Construct a header with correct Merkle branch but wrong execution root. 4. Verify rejection. 5. Test with: truncated branch, extra branch nodes, branch from wrong tree depth, all-zero branch. 6. Verify that a valid header with correct Merkle proof passes.
executable_checks: Submit header with tampered Merkle branch and assert rejection
Submit header with wrong execution root but valid branch structure and assert rejection
Submit header with truncated Merkle branch and assert rejection
Submit valid header and verify acceptance
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-DENEB-LC-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-LC-DATA-SOURCE -> CL. Trust model: all LC headers fully untrusted, Merkle verification mandatory.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for excess_blob_gas reset at fork activation boundary
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct the fork boundary block where parent.timestamp < fork_timestamp <= block.timestamp. 2. Verify excess_blob_gas is reset to 0 in this block. 3. Construct a block just before the boundary (parent.timestamp < fork_timestamp AND block.timestamp < fork_timestamp) and verify no reset. 4. Construct a block just after (both timestamps >= fork_timestamp) and verify no reset (already post-fork). 5. Test with exact timestamp equality: block.timestamp == fork_timestamp.
executable_checks: At fork boundary block, assert excess_blob_gas == 0 regardless of parent value
One block before boundary, assert excess_blob_gas follows pre-fork formula
One block after boundary, assert excess_blob_gas follows post-fork formula without reset
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7762-PRECOND-002. Boundary property at fork activation. Trust model: block producer provides excess_blob_gas which must match computation. Related: ASSUM-EIP7762-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-CALLER-TO-BLAKE2-PRECOMPILE: input length validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Call precompile 0x09 with exactly 213 bytes of valid input. Verify success. 2. Call with 212 bytes (one short). Verify failure. 3. Call with 214 bytes (one over). Verify failure. 4. Call with 0 bytes. Verify failure. 5. Call with 1MB input. Verify failure. 6. Verify gas is still consumed for the call attempt on failure.
executable_checks: CALL 0x09 with 213 bytes and assert 64-byte output returned
CALL 0x09 with 212 bytes and assert failure (empty return)
CALL 0x09 with 214 bytes and assert failure
CALL 0x09 with 0 bytes and assert failure
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP152-PRECOND-001. Boundary: EXT-PRECOMPILE-CALLER -> EL. Trust model: all input fields attacker-controlled, strict 213-byte length required.

checklist.title: Falsify: BLAKE2 F precompile input parsing deviates from specified byte layout
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct 213-byte input with known values: rounds=12 (big-endian at [0:4]), h vector (little-endian uint64s at [4:68]), m block (little-endian at [68:196]), t counters (little-endian at [196:212]), f=1 at [212]. 2. Execute and compare output against reference RFC 7693 BLAKE2b-F computation. 3. Test with rounds=0 (edge case). 4. Test with maximum rounds (0xFFFFFFFF). 5. Verify endianness by using values that differ under big vs little endian interpretation.
executable_checks: Execute with RFC 7693 test vector and compare output byte-by-byte
Execute with rounds=0 and verify output equals input h vector
Verify endianness-sensitive values produce correct output
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP152-INV-001. Invariant falsification: testing byte layout specification compliance. Primary element: ACTION-PARSE-INPUT-FIELDS. Related: AMB-EIP152-02.

checklist.title: Falsify: EIP-7928 fork upgrade modifies existing Fulu BeaconState fields
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Snapshot all Fulu BeaconState fields before upgrade_to_eip7928() call. 2. Execute the upgrade. 3. Compare every Fulu field in the post-upgrade state against the snapshot. 4. Verify ALL existing fields are byte-identical. 5. Verify only the ExecutionPayloadHeader has the new block_access_list_root field appended. 6. Verify block_access_list_root is initialized to Root() (all zeros).
executable_checks: Compare pre/post upgrade BeaconState field-by-field excluding new field
Assert block_access_list_root == Root() (32 zero bytes) after upgrade
Verify hash_tree_root of unchanged subtrees is preserved
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7928-INV-001. Invariant falsification: checking for unintended state modifications. Primary element: ACTION-UPGRADE-TO-EIP7928. Related: ASSUM-EIP7928-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-DAPP-ABI-TO-WALLET: ABI version validation
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Provide an ABI specification with version 'abi-v1'. Verify wallet accepts and processes it. 2. Provide version 'abi-v2'. Verify acceptance. 3. Provide version 'abi-v3' (unsupported). Verify wallet rejects or falls back gracefully. 4. Provide empty version string. Verify rejection. 5. Provide version string with injection characters (e.g., 'abi-v1; DROP TABLE'). Verify safe handling. 6. Verify wallet indicates untrusted ABI source to user in all cases.
executable_checks: Submit ABI with version 'abi-v1' and verify processing succeeds
Submit ABI with unsupported version and verify rejection/graceful fallback
Submit ABI with malformed version and verify no crash or injection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7896-PRECOND-001. Boundary: EXT-DAPP-VIA-WALLET -> EL. Trust model: DApp ABIs untrusted, version validation mandatory. Related: AMB-EIP7896-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-TRUSTED-DB-VERIFICATION: trusted ABI database responses
checklist.bug_class: Trust Boundary Violation / Missing Transport Security
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Verify that ABI database queries use HTTPS (not HTTP). 2. Intercept a response and verify certificate validation occurs. 3. Query for a contract address with no database entry. Verify wallet does NOT treat absence as malicious and indicates 'unverified' status. 4. Query for a known contract and verify the trusted ABI is used for decoding. 5. Test with HTTPS downgrade attempt and verify rejection.
executable_checks: Verify ABI DB queries use HTTPS by checking connection log/config
Query absent contract and verify wallet shows 'unverified' indicator
Query known contract and verify wallet shows 'verified' indicator
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP7896-PRECOND-005. Boundary: EXT-TRUSTED-ABI-DB -> EL. Trust model: HTTPS required, missing entries handled gracefully. Related: AMB-EIP7896-02, ASSUM-EIP7896-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: TSTORE/TLOAD gas cost deviates from 100 gas fixed cost
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Execute TSTORE in a transaction and measure exact gas consumed by the opcode. 2. Verify cost is exactly 100 gas. 3. Execute TLOAD and verify cost is exactly 100 gas. 4. Execute TSTORE on a key that was previously written in the same transaction. Verify cost remains 100 (no warm/cold distinction). 5. Execute with the key in the access list and verify cost is still 100. 6. Compare against SSTORE/SLOAD costs to verify independence.
executable_checks: Execute TSTORE and measure gas delta, assert == 100
Execute TLOAD and measure gas delta, assert == 100
Execute TSTORE on previously-written key and assert gas == 100 (no discount/surcharge)
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-EIP1153-INV-002. Invariant falsification: testing gas cost constancy. Primary element: ACTION-DEDUCT-GAS. Related: AMB-EIP1153-01.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for EDGE-ENGINE-API-PORT-AUTH: JWT authentication enforcement
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send an Engine API request WITHOUT a JWT bearer token. Verify immediate rejection. 2. Send with an expired JWT (iat > 60 seconds ago). Verify rejection. 3. Send with a JWT signed with a different secret. Verify rejection. 4. Send with a valid JWT and verify acceptance. 5. Send with a JWT that has been tampered (modified payload). Verify rejection. 6. Test with empty Authorization header and malformed bearer token.
executable_checks: Send request without JWT and assert HTTP 401/403
Send request with expired JWT and assert rejection
Send request with wrong-secret JWT and assert rejection
Send request with valid JWT and assert success
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ENGAPI-PRECOND-001. Boundary: EXT-ENGINE-API-CALLER -> EL. Trust model: JWT mandatory, invalid/expired/missing tokens rejected immediately. Related: ASSUM-ENGINE-API-01.

checklist.title: Falsify: Forkchoice update does not atomically update head/safe/finalized references
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Send a valid engine_forkchoiceUpdated with new head, safe, and finalized block hashes. 2. Immediately query the EL for current head, safe block, and finalized block. 3. Verify all three references match the provided ForkchoiceState. 4. Send a concurrent engine_forkchoiceUpdated during an ongoing update (race condition test). 5. Verify no partial state is observable (e.g., head updated but finalized not yet).
executable_checks: After forkchoiceUpdated success, query head/safe/finalized and assert all match
Send rapid sequential forkchoiceUpdated calls and verify no partial state observable
Verify SYNCING response during concurrent update attempts
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-ENGAPI-POSTCOND-002. Post-condition falsification: testing atomicity of forkchoice state update. Primary element: ACTION-UPDATE-FORKCHOICE.

checklist.title: Verify Trust Boundary Integrity for gossipped data column sidecar cryptographic verification
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Construct a data column sidecar with valid proposer signature but tampered KZG proofs. Verify REJECT. 2. Construct a sidecar with valid KZG proofs but invalid proposer signature. Verify REJECT. 3. Construct a sidecar with valid signature and KZG but invalid inclusion Merkle proof. Verify REJECT. 4. Construct a sidecar with mismatched proposer index. Verify REJECT. 5. Submit a fully valid sidecar. Verify ACCEPT. 6. Verify all failures produce REJECT (not IGNORE) per spec.
executable_checks: Submit sidecar with invalid KZG proofs and assert REJECT
Submit sidecar with invalid proposer signature and assert REJECT
Submit sidecar with invalid Merkle inclusion proof and assert REJECT
Submit fully valid sidecar and assert ACCEPT
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULU-P2P-PRECOND-003. Boundary: EXT-GOSSIP-PEER -> CL. Trust model: full validation pipeline - signature, inclusion proof, KZG batch verification. REJECT for crypto failures. Related: ASSUM-FULU-P2P-03.

checklist.title: Falsify: Unresponsive custody peer not downscored or disconnected
checklist.detection_procedure: 1. Identify a peer with deterministic custody assignments for specific subnets. 2. Simulate the peer failing to respond to DataColumnSidecarsByRoot requests for their assigned columns. 3. Verify the node's peer scoring mechanism reduces the peer's score. 4. Continue the unresponsiveness and verify eventual disconnection. 5. Verify the downscored peer's data is sought from alternative peers.
executable_checks: Simulate unresponsive custody peer and assert score decreases
Verify peer disconnection after sustained unresponsiveness
Verify data columns are fetched from alternative peers after disconnection
checklist.notes: Source: PROP-W0-FULU-P2P-POSTCOND-001. Post-condition falsification: testing peer downscoring mechanism. Primary element: ACTION-SCORE-PEER-CUSTODY. Related: ASSUM-FULU-P2P-01.
